name: Kurose Sakura
source: Yuuma's younger sister is best friends with Noa. Sakura was involved in an accident several years prior which damaged her legs and in the process caused a trauma for the protagonist. Cannot run or walk for very long due to her legs. She met Azusa at the rehabilitation hospital sometime in the past, which she still visits from time to time.
